text:
ella_sales: Heads up — MosaicCare execs pushed back. POC is blocked on three things: BYO-KMS confirmation, SSO provisioning timeline, and steady-state throughput numbers (they want 40–60 TPS with sub-150ms P95). Legal also asked for a committed price for reserved capacity vs burst. Need an internal exec unblock ASAP.

sam_platform: assigning to infra + eng to validate throughput. @julian_eng can you validate 60 TPS with current batching and kv-cache settings? If not, what's the delta?

julian_eng: running a quick local run now. rough notes: with default batching we hit ~28 TPS at 128 seq. increasing batch_size to 64 and enabling prefix caching gets ~52 TPS in our lab (GPU A100). will test with customer-like prompt mix.

ella_sales: thanks. They will be using longer system prompts and often 512 tokens. can you repro with that distribution?

julian_eng: will do. current perf test command:```bash
wrk -t4 -c50 -d60s --script=generate.lua https://redwood-poc.local/generate
# generate.lua uses 512-token samples and 30% long prompts
```

maria_security: on BYO-KMS: we need confirmation on key wrapping and attestation. MosaicCare requires BYO-KMS with HSM-backed keys and key rotation every 90 days. We can support BYO-KMS for Private deployments only; hosted + dedicated can do customer-managed keys via KMS-integration (no HSM attestation). Legal will need language for the SOW.

tina_gm: flagging: sales needs a one-pager (ops + security) to share with their CISO this afternoon. Ella — can you list the exact asks they will accept? Also, do we have a pricing delta for reserved capacity (monthly commit) vs on-demand burst?

ella_sales: CISO asks: BYO-HSM attestation, SCIM SSO + custom SAML attribute mapping, audit logs for model inputs (retention 90 days), and throughput SLA. On pricing: customer expects a committed discount and predictable invoice for reserved capacity with burst overage cap.

sam_platform: pricing ops — we can offer a 12-month reserved capacity with a 20% discount vs on-demand, plus a defined burst pool charged at blended rate. I'll draft numbers.

julian_eng: quick perf update: repro with 512 seq + mix: avg TPS ~44, P95 ~165ms on A100; with quantization profile 'q4' we get ~58 TPS, P95 ~138ms. caveat: memory pressure goes up, need to validate on customer's model and sequence variety.

maria_security: note: quantization changes may affect compliance attestation for certain regulated workloads. Need legal review before recommending changes for production.

ella_sales: that's helpful. two asks for today: (1) short engineer note confirming we can hit 50 TPS with q4 or config fallback + risks, (2) security one-pager showing BYO-KMS path & limitations. Tina — can you block 3pm for an exec sync if we have docs ready?

tina_gm: booked 15:00 PT hold with MosaicCare execs. Please push draft docs by 13:00 PT. I'll prep the payment/contract alternative.

deploy-bot: deploy 1765432245 failed on staging — OOM on runtime-worker-7, rolling back. (reaction :warning:)

julian_eng: re: deploy-bot — that's the memory pressure I mentioned. I will reconfigure eviction + enable prefix caching on staging and retest. ETA 90m.

ella_sales: great. tagging priorities: perf validation (julian), security doc (maria), pricing paperwork (sam), exec prep (tina). If anyone hits a blocker that affects the 13:00 deliverable, ping here immediately.

sam_platform: noted. I will attach draft pricing numbers to this thread by 12:30.

maria_security: starting security one-pager now; will share a REDLINE by 11:45.

tina_gm: thanks team — let's aim to have a single PDF bundle for the 15:00 call. :rocket:
